name: Halfling
reviewNotes: Walking Speed reduced to 25 feet in the approved comparative Species review; overall balance remains open.

Approved biological revision: Second Chance (reaction reroll of a visible attacker's hit, recharging on initiative or Short/Long Rest) and Bountiful Luck (reaction to share a natural-1 reroll with a visible ally within 30 feet, suspending own Luck Reroll until the end of the next turn). Original feat ability-score increases are not granted; provisional costs 4 and 3.

Needs review; pending approval — Squat Nimbleness (Xanathar's Guide to Everything): compare its mobility and grapple-escape benefits with existing genes and generic Small-creature rules; this is not Halfling-exclusive.
Needs review; pending approval — Underfoot Combat (Races of the Wild, 3.5e): examine maneuvering into the spaces of larger creatures and overlap with Larger-Creature Passage.

Needs review; pending approval — Confound the Big Folk (Races of the Wild, 3.5e): examine tactical effects against larger creatures, feat prerequisites, and overlap with small-creature combat and stealth rules.
